items: 1 vanilla bean (, split and scraped, or 1 teaspoon vanilla extract)
hot water ((1 to 2 tbsp to loosen the batter))

steps: In a mixer bowl, mash the bananas, vanilla and sugar until reaching a smooth consistency.
Gradually add the rice flour while mixing in the food processor bowl. The mixture should be moist but not liquid. Add a little water if necessary, to loosen the batter.
Heat oil in a non-stick pan.
Drop spoonfuls of the batter into the oil. Pay attention to leave enough space between each donut and fry on both sides until browned.
